description: Change a monitor group: its name, whether it alerts as one (a member's failure opens one group incident that pages the group's channels, and the members' own stay quiet), which notification channels the group incident alerts (channel_ids replaces the whole set, and needs the channels:read scope), the reminder interval, and whether another member going down sends a message. Turning alert as one on or off changes only failures that start afterwards. A group managed by Terraform is refused outright. Shows the old and new value of every field before it runs, where the client can show a prompt; otherwise runs on the token's scope. Not read-only.

inputSchema.description:
`update_monitor_group` arguments. Every field except `id` is optional; omit
what should stay as it is.

alert_again.description:
Whether another member going down sends a message or only a timeline
line.

alert_as_one.description:
Turns alerting as one on or off. Only failures that start afterwards
follow the new setting; an incident open now ends the way it started.

channel_ids.description:
Replaces the whole set of channels the group incident alerts, by id
from `list_notification_channels`. Read the group first.

name.description: New name, at most 50 characters. Members keep their group.

renotify_interval_secs.description:
Seconds before the first reminder while the group incident stays
unacknowledged; 0 turns reminders off, otherwise at least 60.

inputSchema.title: UpdateMonitorGroupArgs

name: update_monitor_group

FieldChange.description: One field an update actually moved.

from.description: The value before and after, rendered for reporting back to a human.

changes.description:
What moved. Empty when every value sent already matched the stored one,
in which case nothing was written and no confirmation was asked for.

title: Change monitor group
